notes.title: Patchnotes v1.0.2
notes.content:
Patchnotes v1.0.2
Map generation should be faster now. There's a button to regenerate maps, in case you might encounter one that's impossible to solve. Maps are also a bit more difficult.

All feedback is greatly appreciated. Enjoy! :)

notes.title: Patchnotes v1.0.1
notes.content:
Patchnotes v1.0.1
[list]
	[*] All treasures should be reachable.
	[*] All maps should be possible to finish now.
	[*] All maps contain at least one enemy.
	[*] Minor adjustments to map difficulty.
	[*] Fixed windowed mode.
[/list]
What's next?
I'm considering to add a button to re-generate maps, just in case.
There will be some major updates following and I'd like your suggestions to get these things prioritized.
[list]
	[*] Android (mobile) version
	[*] Translations (Dutch, Russian, Spanish, French...)
	[*] New map types/biomes: picnic (ants), desert (scorpions), sewer (rats)...
	[*] Daily challenges
	[*] More achievements
[/list]

Looking forward to your feedback. ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: ClockwiZZZe getting released: just a few more hours
notes.content:
The things I'm particularly proud of:
[list]
    [*]It's cross platform: Windows, Mac and Linux. Android will follow.
    [*]It has all Steam recommended features: achievements (only 8, more will follow), trading cards (almost), and cloud sync of your savegame.
    [*]Maps are procedurally generated. Each time you play, you have a different world and different maps.
    [*]I absolutely love the music: it's amazing how much it adds to the gameplay and atmosphere.
[/list]
